run_scope: H16 2-head one-layer INT8 true incremental KV Append; tokens 0..3 populate KV; 4..7 run full decode block
model_scope: one-layer H16 two-head INT8 Transformer-style prefill block; synthetic supervised task, not language modeling

training.algorithm: six deterministic integer multiclass perceptrons; no floating-point training
training.gamma_beta: LayerNorm affine parameters use fixed identity initialization (gamma=32768 Q15, beta=0), not trained

host_fallback: model training and Independent Golden only
token IDs 4..7 are supplied by the host; this is not autonomous next-token generation

cache_contract.append_mechanism: K uses legacy word-strided KV_WRITE; V uses opt-in ABI-v7 0x43 flags[0] byte-lane read/modify/write scatter
cache_contract.readback: full 16-word 8x8 Matrix-B tile after each append

events: one-bit ordered completion chain per batch
model_quality: synthetic projection labels; not language-model accuracy
